pairs.why: B's grass is the more saturated clean green like the real card and it shows less sky blue, while A's yellower grass and big blue sky and clouds add a hue family the real card lacks.
A keeps the real card's teal-to-deep-blue background and a muted navy body with no extra accent, while B is a brighter cyan and adds an orange band and orange knob.
A's mid-value, slightly cool green with darker shaded stripes sits nearer the real minty green, while B's yellow-lime green is warmer and lighter.
Both have the same purple sky, lavender-gray ground, blue dome and yellow door, so the palette gives no reason to prefer one.
A has the real card's teal-green top shifting to blue, and a desaturated navy body without added accents, while B is cyan-blue with an orange band and knob.
Both use a red-to-orange background, green seat and cream floor with similar shadow color, so neither is clearly closer to the real coral and pink cast.
A's hat has richer warm-brown shading shifts like the real tan and orange garments, while B is flatter orange with a cream rim that adds a pale accent.
Both rockets use the same cyan background, red and silver body and cyan windows, so the palette gives no reason to choose.
